items.reason: The newly added denial-cache hit returns false before checking permissions or refetching them (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:116-139), and every unsuccessful permission check populates it (service.go:153-154). Its TTL is 30 seconds (service.go:32,85), with no invalidation path, so a subsequent grant cannot take effect for the same request until expiration.

The remote client retains the 30-second LocalCache at pkg/services/authz/rbac.go:160-167. However, the base already used exactly this configuration through newRBACClient (base rbac.go:156-167); this PR merely inlines that construction while disabling caching for the in-process client at head rbac.go:101-105, so the reported remote-cache behavior is pre-existing.
